This article compares the proportion of patients who developed heart failure within the first year after an atrial fibrillation diagnosis, evaluated across different regions and hospital units. The data reveals a general downward trend in these proportions across most major hospitals when comparing the 2020/21, 2021/22, and current reporting periods [^src1].

At the regional level, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] reduced its overall rate from 8.6% in 2020/21 to 5.7% in the current period, while [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] decreased from 8.0% to 5.8% over the same timeframe [^src1]. Among individual facilities, [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] showed a marked decline from 10.2% to 5.9% [^src1]. [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] emerged as the leader among major units with the lowest current proportion at 4.8%, having dropped from 7.5% in 2020/21 [^src1]. 

On the other end of the spectrum, [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] recorded the highest current proportion at 7.1%, though it is the trailer in terms of data completeness, as it lacks historical figures for the two prior periods [^src1]. A significant statistical outlier is [[samso-sundheds-og-akuthus|Samsø Sundheds og Akuthus]], which reported a 0.0% rate; however, this is based on a tiny denominator of just 7 patients, yielding a massive confidence interval of 0.0% to 41.0% [^src1]. 

While most units improved, [[friklinikken-region-syddanmark-grindsted|Friklinikken Region Syddanmark Grindsted]] moved in the opposite direction, with its proportion rising from 2.5% in 2020/21 to 6.6% currently [^src1]. Other hospitals, including [[hospitalsenheden-vest|Hospitalsenheden Vest]], [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]], [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]], [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]], [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital Thisted]], and [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]], experienced varying degrees of decline or stabilization over the tracked periods [^src1].
